historical_references.reference: Venancia of Córdoba was a Christian martyr during the Moorish invasion of Spain in the 8th century. She was a wealthy widow who was tortured and killed for her refusal to renounce her faith. Her relics are now kept in the Basilica of Our Lady of Guadalupe in Córdoba.

Saint Venancia of Saragossa is a Christian martyr venerated in the Catholic Church. She was a young girl who was martyred during the Roman persecution of Christians in the 3rd century. Her relics are now kept in the Monastery of San Pablo in Saragossa, Spain.
